content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-004 Bash History Clearing And HISTFILE Manipulation) OR BIOC(EDR-004 System Log Access Or Truncation) OR BIOC(EDR-004 File Timestomp Via Touch) OR BIOC(EDR-004 Binary Masquerade As Kernel Thread) OR BIOC(EDR-004 Security Product Enumeration) STITCH BY agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id WITHIN 900s
rules.name: Linux Anti-Forensics And Defense Evasion Chain
